asset.trackDescription: Each asset reports what happened to every value you pick, so you can see exactly what is still missing.
asset.untracked: This plan names no values, so results are counted per asset and don't show whether each field was filled.
asset.legend: Each asset should end up with
asset.tagsRequired: Needed because this plan removes or adds tags.
asset.noFieldsPicked: Pick the fields each asset should get. Languages are set below.

metadata.trackDescription: Each entry reports what happened to every value you pick. Canonical URLs, robots settings and images stay untouched.
metadata.untracked: This plan names no specific values, so results are counted per entry and don't show whether each one was written.
metadata.overwriteHint: Existing values stay unless you pick them here. Empty ones are always filled.
metadata.overwriteNone: None. Only empty values are filled.
metadata.fieldsAll: All metadata fields used in this scope
metadata.fieldsHint: None picked: every metadata field on these entries.
metadata.localesHint: None picked: entries in every language. This filters entries and translates nothing.

linked.trackDescription: Each target language also gets the values you pick, written from its translated draft once that is finished. Canonical URLs, robots settings and images stay untouched.
linked.untracked: Metadata fields are translated like other text.
linked.localesHint: None picked: every target language above.

outcome.completedWithGaps: Done with the queue, but some requested outputs are missing

coverage.title: Requested outputs
coverage.unverifiedExplain: This plan doesn't name specific outputs, so entries are counted as a whole. Check the changes themselves to see whether each field was filled.
coverage.counting: Requested outputs are counted when the operation pauses or finishes.
coverage.complete: Every requested output is accounted for

incomplete.completed: Not every requested output was fulfilled
incomplete.paused: Paused with requested outputs still open
incomplete.cancelled: Cancelled with requested outputs still open

incompleteExplain.completed: Finishing means no entry is left in the queue. Open each entry below to see what is missing and why.
incompleteExplain.other: Open each entry below to see what is missing and why.

coverage.entries: {skipped} skipped and {failed} failed entries count as missing.
coverage.questions: {count} output is waiting for an answer. The question is listed below. | {count} outputs are waiting for an answer. The questions are listed below.
coverage.publishing: Nothing is published. Open a draft and publish it when you are happy. Its history is how to go back.
coverage.proposalsWaiting: {count} asset or data entry change waits for you. | {count} asset or data entry changes wait for you.

failure.rate_limited: The AI provider is limiting requests.
failure.unavailable: The AI provider is temporarily unavailable.
failure.connection: The AI provider can't be reached right now.
failure.interrupted: The AI provider's response was cut off.

retry.retries: The provider needed {count} retry so far. | The provider needed {count} retries so far.
retry.unconfirmed: {count} interrupted call may have cost more than the spend shown. | {count} interrupted calls may have cost more than the spend shown.
retry.unconfirmedConfirmed: Known costs are confirmed, but {count} interrupted call may have cost more. | Known costs are confirmed, but {count} interrupted calls may have cost more.

questions.title: Questions
questions.summary: {questions} question on {outputs} outputs | {questions} questions on {outputs} outputs

state.accepting: The rest of the work is finished. These outputs need a fact the agent couldn't establish. Answer what you know. What you leave blank stays blocked.
state.running: The agent is still working through the rest, and more questions may follow. You can answer once it has finished.
state.paused: The operation is paused. You can answer once the remaining work has finished.
state.cancelled: This operation was cancelled, so these questions stay unanswered.

questions.noQuestion: The agent recorded no question for these outputs.
questions.bounds: Only the answered outputs run again, inside the approved plan and the {remaining} left of the budget. An answer gives the agent a fact. It can't widen the plan or replace other values.
questions.budgetSpent: The budget is spent. Your answers are kept, and the operation pauses until you extend the budget.
questions.send: Send {count} answer and continue | Send {count} answers and continue
questions.resuming: {count} answered output is waiting to run. | {count} answered outputs are waiting to run.
questions.stale: Some answers were not applied because their questions changed. Your text is still here. Check it and send it again.
questions.duplicate: Some of these were already answered, so nothing changed for them.
questions.closed: The operation is no longer waiting for answers. Your text is still here.
questions.failed: The answers could not be sent: {error}
